For indeed, among us, the lower things think, but in certain inexpressible heights, the highest powers possess their own mind. And blessed also is their mouth 70.176. They glorify also this in return, not because of weariness, as I might do, but they yield honors to one another more, and repay the glories. For all things above are in the world. Three times 'Holy' they say, they close the doxology, into 'Lord of Hosts,' in one divine nature placing the Holy Trinity. We confess that the Father indeed exists. So also the Son, and the Holy Spirit. And no word divides toward natural difference of the named things, but one divinity is conceived in three hypostases. And through them this has been testified to us by the holy Seraphim, who also say they fill the whole earth with his glory, foretelling the future things, and proclaiming beforehand the mystery of the economy through Christ. Before the Logos became flesh, the wicked dragon, the apostate, held sway under heaven. And the creation was worshiped beside the Creator and Maker. But since the only-begotten Son of God, the Logos, became man, his glory fills the whole earth. For every knee shall bow to him, every tribe, and tongues shall confess, and they shall serve him, according to what is written. Moreover, the blessed David also cried out this in spirit: He said therefore:

All the nations which you made shall come, and they shall worship before you, Lord. This has been fulfilled concerning the called multitude from the nations. And all worshiping through us as it has become for us, remaining through himself for all things. And the lintel was lifted up from the voice with which they cried out, and the house was filled with smoke. For the prophet indeed saw the Lord of Hosts sitting upon a lofty and exalted throne, surrounded in a circle by the holy Seraphim, and with unceasing praises blessing him. And it was confirmed that the house was full of his glory. Now he says that the lintel was lifted up, and that the house was filled with smoke, and that from the voice with which they cried out the holy Seraphim. Then we shall say: Was the voice the cause of the things that happened to the house? And yet how is it not utterly foolish to think thus? What manner then shall we approach the aforementioned notions? Best and wisely. Before the incarnation and presence of our Savior, while still observing the legal polity without hindrance and without addition, that renowned temple in Jerusalem which Solomon erected to the glory of God was full. For they were completing.
pass_b_english: All the nations you have made shall come and bow down before you, Lord. This promise has been fulfilled in the gathering of the peoples called from among the nations.
And all who worship do so through the one who has become for us and remains through himself, above all things.

Then the temple’s lintel was lifted from the sound of their crying, and the house filled with smoke—just as the prophet saw the Lord of Hosts seated on a high and exalted throne, encircled by the holy Seraphim, who never cease to bless him with their praise.
Indeed, it was confirmed that the house was full of his glory.
Now he declares that the lintel was lifted, the house filled with smoke, and that this came from the voice with which the holy Seraphim cried out.
We must ask: Was that voice the cause of what happened to the house? Yet how could it be otherwise than foolish to suppose so? How then should we think about these matters? Best of all, and wisely.
Before our Savior took flesh and dwelt among us, while Israel still kept the law without hindrance or addition, that famous temple in Jerusalem, which Solomon built to the glory of God, was full.
